doc.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022

title: Road logistics
summary: Tiberi had no train-wreck gigs because Brignola kept everything organized.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: all I did was close the octave thing and I gave it to him. And he was just playing as if nothing really happened.
Did you ever — is there anything in your memory like a train wreck type of gig either from the travel or logistics or you know something lost their music? Does anything like pop into your head?

No not really, no. No everything was pretty well organized I think. Mike Brignola had a lot of things to do about that actually. He would always, you know the music was always taken care of and everything was pretty well organized. I never had any problems like that.
